title: Message/query implements pagination offset in Rust rather than SQL
description: MessageQueryHandler calls list_by_chat(&chat_id, limit + position) and then .skip(position as usize) in Rust. This fetches (limit + position) rows from SQLite and discards the first 'position' rows in the application layer. Deep page requests waste proportionally more DB I/O. The offset should be pushed into the SQL query (LIMIT ? OFFSET ?).
